title: Chapter 154 Warning
content:
Chapter 154 Warning

Pick up the energy crystals and soul crystals that fell on the ground.

[Energy Crystals +1W, Soul Crystals +300]

These magic insects actually dropped 300 soul crystals, which Wang Shuo did not expect.

It seems that they were dropped by the mutated magic insects!

And the energy crystals provided by ordinary magic insects are also very considerable, much more than the skeleton warriors.

Just a few more waves like this, and the swarm of insects will not be a big deal!

Wang Shuo did the same thing again, luring monsters, pulling away, and charging back.

Three hours later, the swarm of insects was almost wiped out.

This made Wang Shuo a little confused. Is there no intelligent boss in this canyon?

Who cares!

Wang Shuo had no reason to refuse to be able to effectively kill these insects and gain huge benefits.

At this time, his military merit points had exceeded 100,000.

When Wang Shuo came to the entrance of the canyon again, he did not kill the unhatched eggs, but chose a passage to explore inside.

The winding tunnel was a bit like an ant nest. Most of the places were still quite spacious, and only a few places were only wide enough for one person to pass through by bending over.

Not long after, some mutated Zerg appeared again. Although their level was more than 20, their attack power and health were much lower than those of beasts of the same level, so they killed them all without much effort.

Going deeper, the cave in front of them was even more open. There were even some sparkling gems above their heads, and some places had light from outside the cave shining in.

They didn't feel dark at all, and they didn't even use lighting.

"Hiss..."

Suddenly, a sharp cry echoed in the cave.

Gong Zheng immediately came to Wang Shuo and became alert.

Not long after, another group of mutated demon insects rushed over, and the number was larger than before.

In the cave, although the fighting methods were restricted, the number of demon insects faced at the same time was also limited, so it was considered that each had its own advantages and disadvantages.

Not long after, this wave of demon insects was cleared out again.

"Human, I advise you to stop and quickly leave my territory, otherwise, you will regret it!"

A voice, with an impressive momentum, came from the depths of the cave.

Although Wang Shuo was a little uneasy, it would be too much to scare him away.

"Keep going!"

Along the way, no more demon insects appeared, and Wang Shuo and others successfully came to a huge cave.

The space in front of them was very huge, and the top of the cave was hundreds of meters high. Even if it accommodated thousands of people, it would not feel crowded.

However, in the cave, on a high platform in the center, there was only a demon insect the size of an ordinary gold-eating demon insect, lying on a stone chair, and around him, there were 8 silver-level mutant demon insects.

"What do you think, are you scared? Leave quickly, I can spare your life!" The demon insect on the stone chair opened and scolded.

At the same time, a huge momentum burst out, making people's souls tremble.

Powerful, more powerful than Toad Brunei.

Wang Shuo's forehead was covered with cold sweat, and his mind was a little dazed and his soul was out of his body.

He endured the discomfort and looked with the eyes of delusion.

Wang Shuo almost felt that he was in a hallucination.

He rubbed his eyes again, checked carefully, and then let out a long breath.

Where did the 8 silver bosses come from? There were only 2.
